title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Tactus-web
description:
**Problem**
Low-priority findings from the Tactus-web audit.

**Evidence / Fix** (checklist)
- [ ] Home page title renders as "Tactus | Tactus"; use a descriptive title.
- [ ] islands/hitl.jsx uses a demo customer@acme.com address; confirm it is clearly a placeholder (use an example.com address).

**How to verify**
`curl -s https://tactus.anth.us/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*'` is not "Tactus | Tactus"; `grep -rn acme.com src` prints nothing.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
